entities.name: Raynor Glacier
entities.description: Great glacier in northern Terisiare that covered the kingdom of Storgard.

entities.name: Storgard
entities.description: Kingdom covered by the glacier and its castle destroyed.

entities.name: Soldev
entities.description: Place founded on the ruins of Storgard.

entities.name: Tevash Szat
entities.description: Whose Phyrexian priest amassed black mana in the Labyrinth.

entities.name: Jaeuhl Carthalion
entities.description: Found the Amulet of Quoz in the Labyrinth at the end of the Ice Age.

events.summary: The glacier covers Storgard and eventually destroys its castle; Soldev is later founded on its ruins.
events.quote: It eventually grew over the rest of the kingdom and destroyed its castle.

events.summary: Jaeuhl Carthalion finds the Amulet of Quoz in the Labyrinth of Raynor at the end of the Ice Age.
events.quote: where Jaeuhl Carthalion found the Amulet of Quoz at the end of the Ice Age.
